text: そんなに　がんばらなくても　おしえてやる　って！

structure.jp: そんなに　がんばらなくても
structure.en: even if you don't try that hard

structure.jp: おしえてやる　って！

patterns.name: 〜なくても
patterns.explanation: なくても after a verb means 'even without doing it'. がんばらなくても = 'even if you don't try hard'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb says you do it for someone, in a rough or talking-down way. おしえてやる = 'I'll tell you'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: おしえてやる　って
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of と, which repeats words that were said. At the end of a sentence it repeats your own words to insist on them. おしえてやる　って = 'I said I'll tell you!'.
